title: GP's University of Maryland Machine Learning Classes
summary: A University of Maryland course repository (DATA605/MSML610) collecting lecture materials, tutorials, and student class-project templates, including two duplicate student projects explicitly named 'Synthetic_Data_Vault' that build an end-to-end tabular data pipeline. These notebooks instantiate SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata schema and evaluate output using SDMetrics QualityReport/DiagnosticReport as the core exercise.
needs: Two nearly identical student sub-projects (UmdTask120, UmdTask391) both titled Synthetic_Data_Vault; unclear if either is more canonical or graded/final.
